{{Quote|They love the executions.|Unidentified guard to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], about the crowd on Telos IV|<ref name="TDoR" />}}
This '''unidentified guard''' was [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]]. Sometime in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the guard was part of the group that escorted the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] prisoners [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to their planned execution.<ref name="TDoR" />
